schematic_container_helper.config.commen: Enable or disable the core features of Container Helper.
If enabled, the mod will continuously scan and fill containers in the background.
OFF: Fill looking-at container only. ON: Auto-scan and fill within a specific radius.
The radius for auto-scanning and filling containers (1 - 32 blocks).
The radius for rendering the X-Ray highlight outlines (1 - 64 blocks).
If enabled, only containers within the visible Litematica render layers will be highlighted and filled.
If enabled, the highlight outline will disappear automatically once the container is fully filled.
Highly recommended! Uses data synced by Servux/Tweakmore to verify inventory in the background.
Highlight containers that are missing items with an X-Ray outline.
The color of the highlight outline. Use ARGB hex format (e.g., 0x808B4513).
Delay in ticks between each fill action. Increase this if the server is lagging.
Allow the mod to automatically open shulker boxes in your inventory to extract required materials.
Press to execute a fill action immediately.
Hotkey to quickly enable or disable the continuous background filling.
Hotkey to switch between 'Crosshair Mode' and 'Area Scan Mode'.
Hotkey to open this configuration menu (Default: L + C).
